about.headline: Crafting Digital Excellence

bio.name: Nitin Kanzariya
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer and AI Platform Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade SaaS applications end to end. My work spans the full spectrum — from interactive React/Next.js frontends and real-time WebSocket systems to high-throughput Node.js APIs, Python FastAPI microservices, and .NET backends. I don't just write features; I architect systems that scale.

What sets me apart is the intersection of full-stack engineering and applied AI. I've built RAPTOR-style tree-based RAG pipelines with LangGraph, designed multi-LLM orchestration supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama, and implemented agentic tool-calling systems where AI agents autonomously query live PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB databases — with human-in-the-loop approval gates for safety. I don't use AI as a buzzword; I engineer production AI systems with proper guardrails.

items.title: Aegis — AI Customer Support Platform
features: Designed and developed an AI-powered, multi-tenant customer support platform with RAG-based chatbot creation, real-time agent chat, and Stripe-powered SaaS billing.

Built a dual-store document indexing pipeline — raw pages are chunked and stored as hierarchical tree structures in MongoDB (Page Index), while leaf-node embeddings are simultaneously indexed into Pinecone for vector search.

Implemented an intelligent LangGraph-based query routing engine that classifies user queries, selects relevant documents via LLM reasoning, and traverses document trees to retrieve the most accurate context.
Enabled multi-LLM provider support with dynamic model switching across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama based on tenant configuration and cost considerations.
Engineered real-time chat functionality using Socket.io for live agent–customer conversation handoff with typing indicators and presence tracking.
Developed asynchronous background workers using BullMQ and ARQ for document embedding, email delivery, and cross-store ingestion without blocking API responses.
Implemented secure multi-tenant authentication with JWT + refresh tokens, SAML SSO, role-based access control, plan-based quota enforcement, and AES-256 encryption for tenant API keys.
Integrated Stripe for subscription billing with checkout session creation, webhook-driven plan activation, and usage-based quota management.
Designed a responsive Next.js admin dashboard with analytics charts, knowledge-base management, document upload (PDF, DOCX, web scraping), team invitations, and live conversation monitoring.
Implemented semantic search with hybrid retrieval combining tree traversal and vector similarity, with LLM-powered re-ranking to reduce hallucinations and improve contextual relevance.
Containerized all services with Docker Compose including health checks, resource limits, and inter-service networking for production-ready deployment.
items.description: Production-grade, multi-tenant AI customer support SaaS platform with 4-service distributed architecture — Next.js 16 dashboard, Express.js 5 API with 18+ controllers and 19 Mongoose models, Python FastAPI AI microservice with a 6-node LangGraph agent pipeline featuring RAPTOR-style RAG retrieval, multi-LLM routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Ollama), autonomous database tool execution with human approval gates, and an embeddable Vite/React chat widget with i18n. Includes Stripe billing, SAML SSO, Socket.io real-time chat, and BullMQ job queues.

items.title: RAG ChatBot

Implemented LLM model switching, enabling dynamic selection of language models based on use case, performance, and cost considerations.
Built user-specific vector stores for personalized responses while maintaining a shared global knowledge base for common contextual retrieval.
Integrated document upload during live chat, allowing real-time ingestion, embedding, and querying of PDFs and text files.
Implemented semantic search using vector databases to retrieve the most relevant contextual information and improve response accuracy.
Developed a scalable FastAPI backend to manage embeddings, retrieval pipelines, chat orchestration, and secure API communication.
Designed a modern, responsive Next.js frontend with real-time chat updates and smooth user experience.
Used MongoDB to store chat history, conversation metadata, user preferences, and document references.
Built a chat memory and session management system to preserve conversational context across multiple interactions.
Implemented dynamic prompt customization, allowing users to modify system prompts in real time to control tone, behavior, and response style of the LLM.
Optimized prompt engineering and retrieval pipelines to reduce hallucinations and enhance contextual relevance.
Delivered an enterprise-ready AI assistant capable of document intelligence, personal data recall, and contextual reasoning.
items.description: Full-stack AI chatbot platform with dynamic LLM model switching across multiple providers, personalized vector data stores per user, real-time file upload and document processing during conversations, and Pinecone-powered semantic search with context-aware retrieval. Features modular service architecture with separate chat persistence, document parsing pipeline (PDF, DOCX, web), intelligent chunking strategies, and a clean API layer for seamless frontend integration.

Developed an admin dashboard with retry mechanisms, delivery metrics, and analytics for system monitoring.
Created a Slack slash command integration to update monitoring lists and record incidents directly from Slack.

Applied role-based access control (RBAC) to secure critical features and manage user/admin permissions.
Integrated a custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbot, developed in Python, into the StatusPage as an AI-powered assistant.
